row.notes: Common exit of Car_Contact_ModifyVehicle (its first early-out jumps here too): vmovaps xmm6,[rsp+40h], xmm7,[rsp+50h], xmm8,[rsp+60h]. rsi = the contact record on every path except that first early out. Contact Physics' rigid-body contact (kizi.ai-tweaks, kizi_contact_sim.hpp) computes its contact response here and only uses rsi when it equals the last-contact slot. The early out: cmp [rip+slot],rcx at KB 0x142f04091 (Steam 0x142f06621, same contact as the last call), je at KB 0x142f04098 jumps here before the only write to rsi, mov rsi,rcx at KB 0x142f0409e; on that path rcx still holds the contact record and rsi is the caller's.
